instruction: Use terminal commands to combine the single-column data from file1.xlsx and file2.ods located on the Desktop into a two-column CSV file named fullnames.csv.

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging single-column file1.xlsx and single-column file2.ods into a two-column CSV file. Evaluator verifies that the resulting CSV has exactly 2 columns, at least 1 row of actual data, and contains non-empty cells. This ensures data was actually combined from the source files, not just headers created. Verified by examining source files: file1.xlsx has 1 column (First Name), file2.ods has 1 column (Last Name), so merged file should have 2 columns with combined data.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both structural and content requirements
Metric checks row_count >= 1 (verifies at least one data row, excluding headers)
Metric checks non_empty_cells > 0 (verifies actual content exists)
Getter correctly extracts CSV structure via env.controller.get_file() and parses with csv.reader
Metric parameter handling is correct - directly accesses expected.get('column_count') and expected.get('min_rows')
The three-part check (structure + data rows + content) ensures a CSV with just headers would fail
Coverage is complete: verifies the task requirement to combine data from two files into a two-column CSV with actual content
